description_en: Deletes devices from the blacklist of a system version or application version by calling DeleteVersionBlackDevices
description_zh: 调用DeleteVersionBlackDevices删除系统版本或应用版本的设备黑名单
kebab_example: aliyun iovcc delete-version-black-devices --device-ids 11,22,33 --project-id P0VFCREU --version-type FOTA --version-id 12345 --device-id-type hardware_id --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteVersionBlackDevices

parameters.help_en: The list of device IDs, separated by commas (,). The type of device ID used is determined by DeviceIdType
parameters.help_zh: 设备ID列表，英文逗号隔开。具体设备ID使用哪个，由DeviceIdType决定
parameters.name: device_ids

parameters.help_en:
The version type. Valid values:

FOTA: system upgrade
APP: application upgrade
parameters.help_zh:
版本类型。支持：

FOTA：系统升级
APP：应用升级
parameters.name: version_type

parameters.help_en:
The device ID type. Valid values:

device_id: hardware ID
sn: serial number
vin: vehicle identification number
hardware_id: hardware ID
parameters.help_zh:
设备ID类型，支持：

device_id：硬件ID
sn：序列号
vin：车架号
hardware_id：硬件ID
parameters.name: device_id_type
